about: Tekken Tag Tournament's (PS2) Embu (Theater, MOVIE triangle; script 0x519A90): the storm over the temple courtyard, then Jin, Xiaoyu, Paul, Hwoarang, Eddy and Jun in 13 stretches, Jin turning Devil at the end. In place of Tekken 3's Embu, variant 1, in the attract (the user, 2026-10-20). Converted by tools/ps2/ttt_to_cine.py (docs/CINE-CONVERT.md); its census in handoff/cine-embu.md.

camera.gap_why: Jin's face close-up (489-504, 1 944 px on the PS2): the eye moved in for the focal ended 92 from his face, clipped (the user); kept 450 before the nearest node (300: the fringe cut off), a wider shot
camera.reach_why: the opening crane starts 17 600 from the stage's centre with nobody shown: Tekken 3 draws the arcade temple only within ~6 000 then, it sprang out of nowhere (the user); squeezed past 2 500 to 5 000 at most, the move kept
camera.min_why: the PS2's eye goes down to 151 under the floor (Eddy's shots, the opening): with Arcade Stages' floor, tiles across the sky; raised to 250 above it, the target with it
camera.why: the capture's camera is actor 0's root matrices, which stand still while actor 0 is hidden (the stretches of Xiaoyu and Paul alone, the opening storm): the camera of every frame, read apart (tools/ps2/ttt_embu_camera.py); the Embu changes focal shot by shot (574 to 1944 PS2 pixels), Tekken 3 has one (870): the eye moves instead

ttt_stage.courtyard_why: the TTT floor grid (15 x 15 cells of 1 300) follows the fighters: the Embu's far shots saw its edge, black bands at the balustrades' feet (the user, 600-780 and 1340-1380); the engine draws it around where the camera looks with its 8 neighbours, kept within |x|, |z| <= 12 350, the cell edge past the feet (the stage's tiles x 10 = world, origin shared; 10 000 and 11 050 still left bands, beyond it the floor would cover the lower roofs past the balustrades)
ttt_stage.quiet_why: no thunder: the PS2's Embu has none (the user, 2026-10-21)
ttt_stage.why: TTT arcade's stage 4, the temple in the storm (the user, 2026-10-21; TTT Stages, tekken3_ttt_stage_force), its lightning for the script's cmd 7 (a = the type, the PS2 pictures alike: 4 a bolt then lit clouds, 3 a bolt on the right, 1 lit clouds; 6, a glow then a bolt, has no arcade type: 4)

hide_why: the PS2 draws an actor only while it plays a clip (cmd 2 / 3, frames b to c): nobody in the opening storm, the other actor away while one plays alone (seen on the PS2's own pictures)

music.why: the Embu's own piece, right after the endings' in TEKKEN.BIN (the IOP's stream position in the Embu's save states), up to the next piece's loop-start flags at 112875 (Paul's stage music, heard at the Embu's end when taken along); without the TTT disc, Tekken 3's own Embu music, XAS row 3 from its start (the user, 2026-10-20)

spark_why: the Embu's cmd 10 gives an actor's hit point, numbered as Tekken 3's bones (6 and 10 the hands: Paul's fist at 1834, Jin's crossed fists at 2071 and 2102)

actors.retarget_why: --arm-contacts --arm-gap 350: pulling his glove (511-590) his right hand grips the left forearm on the PS2; on Tekken 3's thicker glove it went into it (the user, validated 2026-10-21 on a slow-motion side by side)
actors.effect_why: Jin's red lightning (the user); no `light`: it colours every character's impact, Paul's punch included
actors.why: the Tekken 3 native, costume 0 (the user); TTT costume 6, the Embu's
